knownIssues.finding: Swift auto redraws changed source page membership/order/visibility; C preserving explicitly refuses and exposes fresh export separately. Both preserving paths support text, images, erasers, rotations and supported xref/object streams.

C fresh export uses a zero-based MediaBox; Swift fresh export retains its grown origin. ArtBox, crop and navigation positions follow the respective coordinate frames. Normalized rasters agree. Preserving geometry agrees within 1e-6 pt.
